in_marathi.name: Amolik

vedic_reference.note: Amolik is a Sanskrit name derived from the words 'अमो' meaning immortal and 'लिक' meaning goal or target. The long meaning of the name is 'अमरतुल्य+ लक्ष्य', which translates to 'goal as immortal as Amrut' or 'goal as pure as Amrut'.
